correctness.rationale: All-q proof establishes the degree profile; A^3=J, unrestricted Laplacian cofactor, legitimate inverse on zero-sum space, rank-one deletion for each nonloop prohibited period-two pair, complete-graph incidence spectrum, strict positivity/strong connectivity, and BEST normalization. Exact integer directed-tree cofactors agree for q=2 and q=3; an independently computed incidence determinant agrees for q=2..8; exhaustive binary rotation classes agree (four). Boundaries q=2, loops and rotation counting checked. Finite computation is not used to justify the infinite statement.

value.rationale: Primitive-only universal cycles are a defined, studied object. Order four is the first composite order where exclusion removes both loops and nonloop period-two transitions, altering the spanning-tree determinant and hence every Eulerian cycle count. The closed formula classifies the exact total for all labeled alphabets, moving from existence/construction to full enumeration; the nontrivial complete-graph low-rank correction supplies a reusable structural technique. This is not an arbitrary small-parameter search.
